label: airMAX LiteBeam 5AC XR
description: 5 GHz airMAX ac station built for extreme-distance links: a 29 dBi integrated parabolic antenna with a 5.5 degree beamwidth, 25 dBm conducted transmit power and 450+ Mbps throughput, reaching roughly 30 km in a point-to-point shot. One Gigabit Ethernet port, powered by the included 24V passive PoE adapter.
notes: Vendor figures: networking interface (1) GbE RJ45; operating frequency 5.15-5.85 GHz (region-dependent); antenna gain 29 dBi; beamwidth 3 dB: 5.5 degrees in both polarisations and elevation; max conducted TX power 25 dBm; total throughput 450+ Mbps; passive PoE 2-pair, 24V DC 0.5A gigabit adapter included; 7W max consumption. The radio rate is modelled at 867 Mbps, the 80 MHz 2x2 airMAX ac PHY rate, matching the other 5AC LiteBeams in the catalogue rather than the 450+ Mbps TCP figure, which is a throughput claim and not a line rate. The 29 dBi antenna and its narrow beam are what separate this from LBE-5AC-Gen2 (23 dBi) and LBE-5AC-LR (26 dBi) - a 30 km link is the design point, not a lab curiosity.
